note: Isaiah wave I-6, chapter 38 Editor. Read base: central v5.0.0 (read-only, read with Python, not edited). Contents: 4 appliesTo extensions with rationale addenda (sheol-underworld-realm-of-the-dead, bor-pit-cistern-dry-water-shaft, hithallekh-lefanai-patriarchal-walking-before-elohim-covenantal-formula, davar-yhwh-prophetic-formula); no wohChoice, claim_type or rationale text changed, so a minor bump. Merge as a union with the other wave I-6 Editors. DELIBERATE NON-EXTENSIONS: chesed-v-emet-steadfast-love-and-truth (only ʾĕmeṯ, not the pair, at 38:3, 18, 19; the Translator's refs were dropped); hithpallel-first-prayer-occurrence (its rationale cites Isa 38:2, but the entry is scoped to first occurrences and the line is the plain 'prayed'); shechin-ra (Job 2:7 phrase; 38:21 has the bare noun šᵉḥîn).

rationaleAppend: Isaiah 38 (isaiah-woh wave I-6): 'the gates of She'ol' (38:10, bᵉšaʿărê šᵉʾôl) and 'She'ol cannot give thanks to you' (38:18) in the psalm of Hezekiah; ASV 'Sheol', JPS 1917 'the nether-world', NJPS 'Sheol', KJV 'the grave' (checked 2026-11-27).

Isaiah 38:18 (isaiah-woh wave I-6): yôrᵉḏê-ḇôr 'those who go down to the pit', parallel to She'ol and death (ASV and JPS 1917 'the pit', NJPS 'the Pit', checked 2026-11-27). šaḥaṯ bᵉlî at 38:17 ('the pit of corruption', ASV) is a different noun and is governed by the isaiah-woh overlay lexical-cruxes-isaiah-38.

Isaiah 38:3 (isaiah-woh wave I-6), the site the rationale already cites with 2 Kgs 20:3: hiṯhallaḵtî lᵉp̄āneyḵā beʾĕmeṯ ûḇᵉlēḇ šālēm 'I have walked before you in truth and with a whole heart' (ASV and JPS 1917 'walked before thee', NJPS 'walked before You', checked 2026-11-27).

Isaiah 38:4 (isaiah-woh wave I-6): wayᵉhî dᵉḇar-YHWH ʾel-yᵉšaʿyāhû lēʾmōr 'Then the word of YHWH came to Isaiah, saying' (ASV 'Then came the word of Jehovah to Isaiah, saying', NJPS 'Then the word of the LORD came to Isaiah', checked 2026-11-27); the parallel 2 Kgs 20:4 has ûḏᵉḇar-YHWH hāyāh ʾēlāyw lēʾmōr with a time clause.
